decision.text: A bundle's relation: its weakest part's. A bundle of broader parts is broadMatch, so a definition passage with only broader parts is partial, as with a single broader card (the maintainer's decision).

fields.absent: the passage has a checked absence
fields.coverage: null, or the passage's bundle as a record of status rule 2 carries it (extensions[locate].coverage, cf-locate-recordset/2): complete, parts (location keys of hasPart locations), challenge (a record challenge value), relation (the bundle's: its weakest part's, one of exactMatch, closeMatch, broadMatch), and, as an exported record carries them, conjuncts ([{id, text, part}], c1..cN in order, each beside the part that states it, every part stating at least one) and bundle_key (64 lowercase hex); keys within these six
fields.expected: the derived status, or null for no status (unresolved)
fields.expected_status_rule_1: what status rule 1 derives over the same locations and the claim's three D1 keys (complete, parts, challenge), where that projection is one rule 1 reads: beside the expectation it shows what status rule 2 changes
fields.locations: the passage's surviving locations after challenge: location_key, relation, proof_status (joined from the library index), statement (the Prop-valued definition flag)
fields.refused: true when the inputs are a contradiction the function refuses
fields.status_rule: 2 on every case: the version of the derivation (status rule 1's cases are tests/data/locate/status-parity.json, cf-locate-status-parity/1, unchanged)

function: derive_status(passage_kind, locations, absent, coverage, status_rule=2) -> status | null

reading.text: Under status rule 2 a coverage claim is a bundle on a compound statement. A survived bundle acts, for the derived status, as one more location of the bundle's own relation (its weakest part's, one of exactMatch, closeMatch, broadMatch), where status rule 1 makes it one more exactMatch; its proof status is the same fixed stand-in (finished when every part is proved or data: a proved declaration on the theorem row and a definition on the definition row; otherwise statement_only on both rows). Everything else is status rule 1: a bundle that is not survived adds nothing, example and other passages take the better of both rows, and the best status over all the evidence wins. Only the definition row's broadMatch changes: a bundle of broader parts on a definition, construction or notation passage is partial.
